# How this repository was made

**Everything in this repository that isn't in pret's history was generated by AI**
(LLM coding agents), with a person choosing the work and reviewing the results. None
of it comes from pret, and pret has nothing to do with it.

## What is AI-generated

The repository is a fork of [pret/pokeheartgold](https://github.com/pret/pokeheartgold).
pret's commits are kept unchanged in the history. Everything after the fork point is
AI-generated:

```bash
git log 0985e8718..main        # every AI-generated commit (0985e8718 = pret's last commit here, 2026-08-22)
git diff 0985e8718 main        # everything they changed
```

| Period | Commits | Work | Made with |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-09 to 2026-10-21 | about 780 | finishing the decompilation (assembly to C/C++), naming, types, cleanup, progress tooling | LLM coding agents; the commits don't record which model |
| 2026-10-21 | 1 | moving the build to pret's newer Meson build system | Claude (Claude Code) |
| 2026-10-21 onward | `[AI-LOCAL]` commits | modding layout and tools (maps, scripts, data as JSON/PNG, sound), named constants, the guides in `docs/` | Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code; each commit carries a `Co-Authored-By: Claude` line |

The `[AI-LOCAL]` prefix dates from when the work was kept local; it marks AI-generated
commits.

**In the files:** files the agents wrote or rewrote start with a comment like

```
// [AI-GENERATED / NOT AFFILIATED WITH PRET] claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-22
```

and the guides start with "AI-generated; not affiliated with pret". Files changed in
the first period, and small edits to pret's files, don't all carry a mark: use the
`git log` range above to be sure.

## How it was checked

- **Both ROMs build byte for byte.** Every change keeps HeartGold and SoulSilver
  matching the retail ROMs; `make` checks the main and sub binaries, every file in the
  ROM's filesystem, and the whole ROM against their SHA-1s. Matching means the
  game is unchanged. It does **not** mean every name, type or comment is right.
- **Data conversions round-trip.** Each converter (maps, scripts, items, moves,
  learnsets, trainer sprites, sound) has tests that rebuild the original files from the
  new sources byte for byte. They are listed in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#checks).
- **Guides cite the code.** Statements in `docs/` name the file and line they come
  from. What was only read in the code and not tried in the game is listed under
  **Not verified** at the end of each guide.
- **Session log.** [docs/AI_WORK_LOG.md](docs/AI_WORK_LOG.md) records, for the early
  sessions, what changed, the model, and how it was checked;
  [docs/DECOMP-NOTES.md](docs/DECOMP-NOTES.md) has notes from the decompilation.

## What that means for you

- Names, comments and documentation can be wrong in ways the matching build can't
  catch. If something in a guide disagrees with the code, the code wins; please open
  an issue.
- Nothing from here should go to pret: not code, not data, not documentation. pret does
  not accept AI-generated work and does not want to be associated with it.
- Contributions here can be AI-generated or not; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
